delta_n_elec_max_z.use: electronic Kerr strength and self-focusing onset

delta_n_rot_max_z.source: propagate.py: delta_n_rot = n_R * (Raman convolution of I)
delta_n_rot_max_z.use: delayed Kerr contribution and Raman ablation studies

IR_max_z.use: verify Raman convolution magnitude along propagation

IR_abs_max_z.use: detect signed Raman response even when its positive maximum is small

fwhm_time_z.meaning: on-axis temporal intensity full width at half maximum

dphi_kerr_max_abs_z.meaning: maximum absolute applied total Kerr phase per nonlinear step
dphi_kerr_max_abs_z.source: propagate.py: dphi_k after optional self-steepening correction
dphi_kerr_max_abs_z.use: nonlinear phase budget and step-size diagnosis

dphi_elec_max_abs_z.meaning: maximum absolute electronic-Kerr phase estimate before optional self-steepening correction
dphi_elec_max_abs_z.use: separate electronic Kerr from rotational Raman in a phase budget

dphi_rot_max_abs_z.meaning: maximum absolute rotational-Raman phase estimate before optional self-steepening correction
dphi_rot_max_abs_z.use: separate delayed Raman Kerr from electronic Kerr in a phase budget

dphi_plasma_max_abs_z.meaning: maximum absolute applied plasma phase per nonlinear step

delta_n_elec_applied_max_z.meaning: maximum electronic-Kerr refractive-index increment admitted to the propagation phase

delta_n_rot_applied_max_z.meaning: maximum rotational-Raman refractive-index increment admitted to the propagation phase

delta_n_plasma_applied_min_z.meaning: most negative plasma refractive-index increment admitted to the propagation phase
delta_n_plasma_applied_min_z.source: propagate.py: plasma phase gated by use_plasma_phase

dphi_elec_applied_max_abs_z.meaning: maximum electronic-Kerr phase estimate admitted before optional self-steepening
dphi_elec_applied_max_abs_z.use: separate raw and applied electronic Kerr

dphi_rot_applied_max_abs_z.meaning: maximum rotational-Raman phase estimate admitted before optional self-steepening
dphi_rot_applied_max_abs_z.use: separate raw and applied rotational Raman

dphi_plasma_raw_max_abs_z.meaning: maximum plasma phase calculated from rho before switch gating
dphi_plasma_raw_max_abs_z.use: verify rho-derived plasma diagnostics when feedback is OFF

dphi_plasma_applied_max_abs_z.meaning: maximum plasma phase admitted to propagation
dphi_plasma_applied_max_abs_z.source: propagate.py: raw plasma phase gated by use_plasma_phase

alpha_ion_corr_max_z.meaning: maximum ionization-loss coefficient used in propagation
alpha_ion_corr_max_z.source: propagate.py: alpha_ion after optional operator correction

alpha_ion_raw_max_z.meaning: maximum ionization-loss coefficient before optional operator correction
alpha_ion_raw_max_z.use: quantify the effect of the ionization operator correction

alpha_ib_max_z.use: separate plasma collisional loss from ionization loss

alpha_R_eff_z.meaning: effective Raman absorption coefficient used in propagation

alpha_R_closed_z.meaning: effective Raman coefficient from the closed-form absorption branch; zero for other Raman models
alpha_R_closed_z.source: propagate.py: closed_form / alpha_local Raman absorption branch
alpha_R_closed_z.use: distinguish the closed-form Raman-loss branch from convolution-derivative loss

alpha_total_max_z.meaning: maximum total absorption coefficient applied to the field
alpha_total_max_z.use: total nonlinear attenuation budget and step-size diagnosis

alpha_ion_applied_max_z.meaning: maximum ionization-loss coefficient admitted to total field attenuation
alpha_ion_applied_max_z.use: separate potential ionization loss from propagated loss

alpha_R_raw_max_z.meaning: maximum Raman absorption coefficient calculated before switch gating
alpha_R_raw_max_z.use: retain Raman-loss diagnostics when propagation feedback is OFF

alpha_R_applied_max_z.meaning: maximum Raman absorption coefficient admitted to total field attenuation

E_dep_z.meaning: ionization plus inverse-Bremsstrahlung energy deposited in each recorded z step

E_dep_rot_z.meaning: rotational-Raman energy deposited in each recorded z step

E_dep_total_z.meaning: sum of ionization/IB and Raman deposited energy for each recorded z step

E_dep_cumulative_z.use: compare cumulative material deposition along z

U_rel_change_z.meaning: pulse-energy change relative to the input propagation plane

U_step_change_z.meaning: pulse-energy change over each recorded propagation interval
U_step_change_z.source: propagate.py: U_z difference from previous record (first uses U0)
U_step_change_z.use: localize sudden energy-loss or numerical-instability events

E_loss_from_input_z.meaning: observed pulse-energy loss relative to the input propagation plane
E_loss_from_input_z.use: compare field-energy loss against deposited-energy diagnostics

rho_N2_max_z.meaning: maximum N2 electron density over time and transverse coordinates
rho_N2_max_z.source: propagate.py: existing per-species rho_list returned by evolve_rho_time
rho_N2_max_z.use: separate N2 contribution from total plasma density

rho_O2_max_z.meaning: maximum O2 electron density over time and transverse coordinates
rho_O2_max_z.source: propagate.py: existing per-species rho_list returned by evolve_rho_time
rho_O2_max_z.use: separate O2 contribution from total plasma density

rho_O2_fraction_at_rho_total_max_z.meaning: O2 density fraction at the spatiotemporal maximum of total electron density
rho_O2_fraction_at_rho_total_max_z.use: identify species controlling the local total-density maximum

dz_used_z.meaning: actual accepted propagation step used to reach each recorded z sample
dz_used_z.source: propagate.py: live dz_try in the propagation loop
dz_used_z.use: distinguish physical changes from actual propagation-step changes

adaptive_rejection_count_z.meaning: cumulative count of actual propagation-step rejections at each recorded z sample
adaptive_rejection_count_z.use: verify whether rejection/retry logic affected a comparison

safety_mode_trigger_count_z.meaning: cumulative count of actual safety-mode triggers at each recorded z sample
safety_mode_trigger_count_z.use: verify whether safety-mode control altered a comparison

raman_operator_applied.meaning: whether the complete Isaacs Raman field operator was applied at each z step
raman_operator_applied.use: distinguish raw Raman diagnostics from field feedback

raman_rhs_l2_norm.meaning: maximum stage L2 norm of the applied full Raman RHS

raman_IR_max_raw.meaning: raw maximum delayed Raman intensity response
raman_IR_max_raw.use: retain Raman response in ON and feedback-OFF controls

raman_target_loss_step_J.meaning: Eq. (10) target rotational energy loss for the current step

raman_actual_loss_step_J.meaning: actual field-energy loss caused by the full Raman operator
raman_actual_loss_step_J.source: field fluence before/after the isolated Raman update

raman_closure_residual_step.meaning: relative Eq. (10) target-versus-actual Raman loss residual

raman_cumulative_closure_residual.meaning: relative cumulative target-versus-actual Raman loss residual

raman_convolution_count_step.meaning: number of Raman convolutions evaluated for the current full step

raman_operator_walltime_step_s.meaning: wall time spent in full Raman stage/update calculations

raman_operator_substep_count.meaning: number of isolated full Raman operator applications in one propagation step
raman_operator_substep_count.use: interpret total convolution count for Strang splitting

linear_walltime_step_s.meaning: synchronized wall time of both linear half steps

ionization_walltime_step_s.meaning: synchronized ionization/plasma source calculation wall time

gpu_allocated_step_bytes.meaning: CuPy memory-pool bytes actively allocated after each step

gpu_reserved_step_bytes.meaning: CuPy memory-pool bytes reserved after each step

raman_energy_projection_iterations.meaning: complex64 energy-projection iterations used by the full Eq.27 step

raman_energy_projection_scale_deviation.meaning: maximum absolute deviation of the projection scale from unity
raman_energy_projection_scale_deviation.use: bound the numerical correction applied to the field

raman_energy_projection_initial_residual.meaning: stored-field closure residual before the quantization projection
raman_energy_projection_initial_residual.use: separate Eq.27 closure from complex64 storage error
